title: Real-Estate Listing & Rental Management System
description: A full web platform for property listings and rental management — handles listings, tenant onboarding, lease agreements, rent tracking, and an admin dashboard. Built end to end as a self-employed developer.

title: Development — Web & Mobile Projects
description: A collection of practical web and mobile applications built to solve real problems. Includes full-stack demos, UI experiments, and hands-on projects that reflect my practical problem-solving approach.

title: REST API for Property Management
description: FastAPI backend powering property listings, tenant records, and rental agreements. Includes JWT authentication, role-based access, and Pydantic validation across all endpoints.

title: Admin Dashboard for Property Managers
description: React + Tailwind admin interface to manage listings, tenants, and rental payments. Includes real-time stats, filtering, and a clean data-table workflow.

title: FastAPI Tutorial
description: A hands-on FastAPI learning project covering routing, request handling, data validation, and API design patterns — the foundation for every backend I build.

title: Netflix Clone
description: A pixel-focused clone of the Netflix interface — built to sharpen layout, responsive design, and CSS fundamentals.
